title: Foods to Limit or Cook Thoroughly During Pregnancy
excerpt: Food-safety guidance inspired by CDC/NHS/FDA themes: deli meats, unpasteurized dairy, high-mercury fish, and undercooked foods.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, it's essential to choose safe and healthy foods to ensure the well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we'll provide information on foods that pregnant women should limit or cook thoroughly to avoid health risks.

## Foods to Limit
According to the CDC, NHS, and FDA, pregnant women should limit the following foods:

* Deli meats and cold cuts: These may contain listeria, a bacteria that can harm the fetus.
* Unpasteurized dairy products: Unpasteurized dairy products can contain E. coli, Salmonella, and Listeria.
* High-mercury fish: Fish high in mercury, such as shark, swordfish, and king mackerel, can contain mercury, a toxic substance that can harm the fetus.
* Undercooked or raw foods: Undercooked or raw foods, such as sushi, sashimi, and raw eggs, can contain Salmonella and other bacteria.

## Foods to Cook Thoroughly
To ensure safety, pregnant women should cook the following foods thoroughly:

* Meat and poultry: Cook meat and poultry to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to ensure safety.
* Eggs: Cook eggs to an internal temperature of at least 165°F (74°C) to ensure safety.
* Seafood: Cook seafood to an internal temperature of at least 145°F (63°C) to ensure safety.

## Practical Tips
Here are some practical tips to help pregnant women choose safe foods:

* Read food labels: When buying food, read the labels to ensure that the food has been pasteurized or cooked thoroughly.
* Cook food thoroughly: Cook food to the recommended internal temperature to ensure safety.
* Avoid undercooked or raw foods: Avoid undercooked or raw foods, such as sushi, sashimi, and raw eggs.

## When to Seek Help
If pregnant women have any questions or concerns about food safety, they should consult their doctor or a registered dietitian. They can provide specific information and advice to help pregnant women choose safe and healthy foods.

## Conclusion
Choosing safe and healthy foods is crucial to ensure the well-being of both mother and baby. We hope that the information in this article will help pregnant women understand which foods to limit or cook thoroughly.
